commands.name: ls
commands.summary: Read the screen of the front app, or of the named app, and the actions it accepts. Read-only.

args.name: app
args.description: The app to read. Defaults to the front app.

layer.description: Which layer reads the screen: auto, the accessibility tree (ax) or pixels.

diff.description: Show only what changed since the last read.

commands.name: gate
commands.summary: Say whether the screen is open to an agent right now, and why not if it is not. Read-only.

args.name: action
args.description: check (the default), wait, init, pre, post or show.

idle.description: How long nobody must have used the Mac. Defaults to 90.

max-min.description: With wait: how many minutes to wait at most.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Report what this Mac has for hackamore and the next step if something is missing. Read-only.

commands.name: do
commands.summary: Run one action on an app on this Mac, which other people may see, and read the screen after it. A person says yes first.

args.name: action
args.description: The action to run, as ls lists it.

args.name: inputJson
args.description: The action's input as a JSON object.

app.description: The app to act on. Defaults to the front app.

idle.description: Refuse unless nobody has used the Mac for this many seconds.

record.description: Write the step to this file, for a journey.

diff.description: Show only what changed after the action.

commands.name: batch
commands.summary: Run a list of steps on an app on this Mac, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

args.name: steps
args.description: A JSON array of {action, input, until?, app?} steps.

app.description: The app to act on by default.

idle.description: Refuse unless nobody has used the Mac for this many seconds.

record.description: Write the steps to this file, for a journey.

diff.description: Show only what changed after the last step.

commands.name: journey
commands.summary: Replay a recorded journey of steps on an app on this Mac, which other people may see. A person says yes first.

args.name: file
args.description: A JSON file of recorded steps.

commands.name: agent
commands.summary: Say whether the resident Ouro Reins Agent is running; install and build change only this Mac, and grant needs a person at it.

args.name: action
args.description: status (the default), install, build or grant.

from.description: With install: the folder to install from.

force.description: With install: replace what is installed.

developer-id.description: With build: sign with a Developer ID certificate.

person-here.description: With grant: only with a person at the Mac.

commands.name: wire
commands.summary: Serve one JSON request line from stdin for another Mac that drives this one with --via, which other people may see. A person says yes first.
